zara_csm: Quick sync  Spark alpha enrollments at 4/18 active. Two orgs flagged low-engagement. Want to run a rapid "first-result" play to drive immediate value and capture renewal intent.

miguel_se: Agree. Proposal: 20m hands-on lab + 15m office hours. Pre-seed a tiny dataset so they get a result in <8m. I can make a one-file Python example.

ana_pm: Can we also include a 2-question post-session pulse? 1) Did you get a working rerank? (y/n) 2) Renewal intent (scale 1-5). Short & actionable.

ben_enable: I can schedule two slots: 09:00 PT and 17:00 CET. Will add an RSVP that includes a short checklist: API key, sample dataset, expected runtime.

zara_csm: For incentives, finance okayed a $120 usage credit for first 5 orgs that run the lab. Target the two at-risk accounts: Spark-Intl (ARR $24k) and Spark-Docs (ARR $11k).

miguel_se: Snippet preview (will push full repo):
```
# python quick-run
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RD_KEY'))
resp = c.rerank(model='tiny-rank', query='invoice', documents=['Inv A','Inv B'])
print(resp)
```
Will add a pre-seeded small CSV and README.

ana_pm: I'll draft a 4-slide deck: "what to expect", "integration checklist", "common blockers", "next steps". Also create the pulse form and share link.

ben_enable: Opsbot created calendar drafts: Spark alpha office hours  Tue May 7 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/spark-alpha-2100

zara_csm: Action items: Miguel - repo + snippet (EOD). Ana - slides + pulse form (tomorrow AM). Ben - invites + checklist + credit coordination (today). I'll tag the two at-risk accounts in CRM and prepare renewal risk notes. Reconvene Fri 10am PT to review RSVPs.

miguel_se: Pushing repo link now: https://drive.redwood.com/spark-labs/first-result (contains snippet, csv, README).
